_comment: Unified prompt-router config (v3, 2026-09-27). The router evaluates the ENTIRE trigger floor at runtime (classify.py::_floor_index) with word-boundary matching, then ranks <= max_skill_pushes skills above min_skill_score by surface (FE/BE/API/docs from prompt paths + vocab, cwd, repo stack), intent, and the curated category lists. consumes_entire_floor=true is what build-trigger-floor.py --check verifies. Router-only tuning lives under 'additions' — never edit the floor by hand.

priority_tiers.0: gate-adjacent — first-write baseline, TDD (backend surface / TEST intent only)
priority_tiers.1: substrate precedence (jcodemunch for code, jdocmunch for docs, graphify for architecture) + indexed symbols + at most ONE deep-injected skill body
priority_tiers.2: ranked skill pushes: rank 1 MUST-READ, ranks 2-5 SHOULD-READ; aliases collapsed; core-skill-set skills never re-pushed
priority_tiers.3: routing (UI signal, MCP routes, /invoke act or specialist dispatch, per-project model mode) + model advice

dedup.invariant: suppresses verbatim re-injection only; never suppresses a first fire

additions._comment: Router-only trigger ADDITIONS atop the floor. intents: extra act keywords per category (same <=3-char rule as the floor). surface_skills: surface/tag -> {skill: boost}; a boost from a stack-only inference is multiplied by weak_surface_factor. skill_rules: regex (on the lower-cased prompt) -> skill boost, optionally gated on surfaces. Plugin skills use the plugin:skill name; every candidate must exist on disk (local skill dir or installed plugin) or it is dropped.

demote._comment: Process/meta skills multiply by this factor before the score floor: they are doctrine (CLAUDE.md, core-skill-set) rather than surface skills, and without a demotion they take 2 of the 5 slots on every build prompt. A strong intent signal (PLAN/SPEC/DEBUG category boost) still lifts them over the floor.
